title: Forager's Stash
description: Tucked beneath a fallen mushroom cap, you find a forager's abandoned stash -- woven baskets stuffed with dried fungal fibers, sealed jars of preserved spores, and a leather coin pouch. The owner seems to have left in a hurry.

choices.label: Take the fibers and threads
choices.description: Grab the fungal fiber and mycelium thread -- practical materials.

outcomes.text: The baskets are well-packed. You pull out bundles of dried fiber and neatly wound mycelium thread -- someone knew their craft.
Buried beneath the fiber bundles, you find a hidden pouch of rare spore clusters wrapped in wax paper. The forager was collecting more than basics.
As you lift the basket lid, a burst of trapped spores hits you in the face. You grab what you can through watering eyes.

choices.label: Search for valuables
choices.description: Check the coin pouch. Foragers always keep emergency gold.

outcomes.text: The pouch is heavier than it looks. A decent stash of coin -- the forager won't be needing it.
Gold coins and a few loose gems tucked into a side pocket. This forager was doing well for themselves.
The pouch is mostly copper -- barely worth the stop. Something already picked through the best of it.

choices.label: Move on
choices.description: Leave the stash. Whoever left it may return.

outcomes.text: You step past the stash and continue deeper into the tunnels. Not everything needs to be taken.
